jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.

Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

À propos de nous

E-finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans les solutions de gestion financière et de trésorerie. Nos solutions permettent aux entreprises d'optimiser la gestion de leurs flux financiers, d'améliorer leur visibilité sur leur trésorerie et de renforcer leur performance financière.

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre l'aventure et laisser une vraie empreinte sur ce que nous construisons.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Afwisseling: Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je werkt. Dit geeft je vrijheid in je werk, maar zorgt er ook voor dat je een goede werk-privé balans kan behouden;

Er is aandacht voor de inhoud van het onderzoek én voor jouw ontwikkeling. Zo leer je nieuwe onderzoeksvaardigheden en krijg je ruimte om medische handelingen verder te oefenen.
De vaste werktijden en duidelijke planning brengen structuur in je week. Daardoor houd je aandacht voor kwaliteit, zorgvuldige verslaglegging en de deelnemers die je begeleidt. Wat breng je mee?

A Control Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and support of industrial control and automation systems for large‑scale capital projects. jobs.title: Tips for Candidates
jobs.description:
This document has been put together to help you prepare for your arrival in the Netherlands. You are
going to work in the Netherlands, and so below are some tips to help you prepare as well as possible.
We advise you to ask your future employer as many questions as possible to ensure you are well
prepared when you start work.
Description of the agricultural sector
• Much of the work is done outside, in all kinds of weather (rain and hot sunshine). Ask your
employer for any photos and/or films of the work you will be doing. Tip: search Google and
YouTube for videos / photos of the work involved.
• Work in the agricultural sector is seasonal and depends on the weather. Favourable weather
conditions can boost production within a short space of time. This will result in a lot of work
and you may be able to work more (extra) hours. It's just as likely that, due to the weather,
production levels do not rise as quickly as expected, and that you consequently work fewer
hours than usual. In that case, your employer may give you other work to do.
• Agricultural businesses are often located in remote areas, some distance from the nearest
large town. Facilities and amenities such as a supermarket or train station will often not be
close by.
• Accomodation varies from business to business and will often be located close to the
field/building you are working in. The agricultural businesses provide accommodation for their
workers, and this could be on a campsite, a container home, shed, caravan, house, etc.

Voor Arkema B.V. - locatie Rotterdam zijn wij per direct op zoek naar een ervaren HSE medewerker (1 FTE).
Wat ga jij doen?
In deze functie ben jij bezig met het verrichten van HSE werkzaamheden op o.a. de gebieden advisering ten aanzien van Safety en risico-inventarisatie, organisatie en beheer van de calamiteitenorganisatie, incidentenonderzoek, buitenronde toezicht, afval coördinatie, klachtenbehandeling, MSDS beheer en projecten e.e.a. binnen wettelijke kaders en volgens bedrijfsbeleid.
Een greep uit jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden: - Jij ziet in de organisatie toe op handhaving en naleving van milieu- en veiligheidsvoorschriften. - Jij bent bezig met administratieve handelingen in het kader van verschillende zorgsystemen, zoals het vastleggen van audits en KPI's en opstellen van procedures en werkinstructies. - Jij begeleid programma's gericht op verbetering van HSE-prestaties. - Jij voert incident en near miss evaluaties uit. - Jij zorgt voor het verzamelen van de juiste gegevens en opstellen van HSE rapportages. - Jij beheert HSE acties en voert algemene inspecties en veiligheidsrondes uit.
De Afdeling
De afdeling HSE is verantwoordelijk voor de integrale borging van het HSE beleid. Het HSE beleid is binnen de onderneming primair een lijnverantwoordelijkheid. jobs.description:

Le défi : ce poste consiste à identifier soi-même les enjeux et opportunités du marché français, puis à construire et exécuter la stratégie qui en découle — de bout en bout. Le poste est pensé pour quelqu'un qui est à l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, et pour qui la construction d'une stratégie compte autant que sa mise en œuvre concrète sur le terrain.

Requirements

Le poste, en synthèse :

  • Piloter le marché France de bout en bout : diagnostic des enjeux et opportunités, construction de la stratégie, exécution.
  • Déterminer le marketing mix et faire des recommandations stratégiques sur le mix média payant.
  • Piloter la collaboration quotidienne avec l'agence média, garantir l'alignement stratégique et l'optimisation continue des canaux payants.
  • Construire des plans marketing intégrés multicanaux (média, influence, RP, partenariats), de la rédaction du brief à l'analyse de performance.
  • Communiquer régulièrement les enjeux du marché, la stratégie et les résultats à la direction et aux parties prenantes transverses.
  • Adapter les apprentissages globaux au marché français, et remonter les enseignements locaux à l'organisation globale.

Profil recherché :

  • Solide expérience en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à superviser des responsables de canaux (channel leads) et à porter une stratégie globale cohérente.
  • 8 à 10 ans d'expérience en marketing de marque, marketing intégré ou marketing stratégique, idéalement dans la tech grand public, le lifestyle ou des marques à forte identité culturelle.
  • Expérience en marketing et/ou média avec une expertise approfondie et une réelle compréhension du marché français.
  • Expérience avérée de pilotage autonome d'un marché, du diagnostic des enjeux jusqu'à l'exécution.
  • Expérience avérée du lancement de campagnes multicanales générant à la fois de la connexion émotionnelle et des résultats mesurables.
  • Bonne compréhension du paysage média, des canaux et de la mesure de performance.
  • Solides compétences analytiques, avec une utilisation démontrée de la donnée et des indicateurs pour mesurer l'impact des actions et ajuster la stratégie en conséquence.
  • Expérience dans la gestion de partenariats avec des célébrités, talents, influenceurs ou créateurs de contenu, y compris la gestion de relations avec des agences, est un plus.
  • À l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, de façon autonome.
  • Français natif ou bilingue, anglais courant indispensable.

Benefits

Conditions : France, full remote — Rémunération : 100 000 € à 111 000 € brut/an — Prise de poste : 1er octobre.

jobs.description:
Office Responsible -- Join Our International Team in Norway

We are currently seeking a dedicated and motivated Office Responsible to join our dynamic team. This is a key role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys balancing structure, communication, and customer service. If you are detail-oriented, solution-driven, and looking to contribute to a growing company in the travel and outdoor industry, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About the Role

As the Office Responsible, you will be the first point of contact for many of our customers and a central figure in our day-to-day operations. You will handle booking and pre-booking coordination, assist with post-rental customer service, and manage internal support functions such as invoicing and payment allocations.

You will also provide critical backup to our rental agent team when needed, offering variety and ensuring smooth operations across departments. This position requires strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to stay focused when working with complex information.

We are looking for a candidate who brings prior experience in coordination work or a similar office-based role, and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a structured and organized manner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide customer support before, during, and after the booking process through email, phone, and online chat

  • Manage booking entries and updates within our booking system

  • Handle deposit processing, damage claims, and customer inquiries post-rental

  • Allocate ferry tickets, tolls, and parking fees to the correct bookings

  • Process invoices, purchase orders, and general company paperwork

  • Support internal accounting by preparing accurate Excel spreadsheets

  • Assist the rental team with operational tasks during busy periods

  • Suggest and support improvements to office workflows and processes


Who We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in coordination, administration, or a similar office-based role

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (Norwegian is not required)

  • Excellent focus and attention to detail, especially when working with data and allocations

  • Solid working knowledge of Excel and basic accounting practices

  • A problem-solver with a service-oriented mindset

  • Positive, proactive, and eager to take initiative

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • Open to supporting and collaborating with a diverse, international group


Our Work Environment

You will be joining a young and international team based in Norway, made up of outdoor-minded individuals from around the world. Our company language is English, and our work culture values openness, collaboration, and initiative. While the position is office-based, you will be part of a business that supports adventurous travel experiences across the country.

Why Join Us

This is an excellent opportunity to take on a varied and responsible role within a growing company. You will work closely with management and other departments, contribute directly to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, and be encouraged to bring your ideas to the table.

We offer a supportive and flexible work environment, where professional development is valued, and where your role can evolve as the company grows.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers is Norway's largest camper van rental company, offering 200 camper vans across two locations: Oslo and Tromsø. With over 10 years of experience, we specialize in helping tourists explore and enjoy the stunning Norwegian nature. Our goal is to provide unforgettable adventures, giving you the freedom to discover Norway at your own pace.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - CDI - Full-Time - (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant – Corporate Governance & Board Support (M/F/X)

About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission

As an Executive Assistant reporting to the General Secretary, you will serve as the primary point of coordination for the CEO's office, managing the executive diary, organising leadership meetings and ensuring seamless communication between the CEO, internal teams and external stakeholders. You will also play a central role in corporate governance by coordinating Board of Managers meetings and General Assemblies and maintaining compliance with Luxembourg's legal obligations.
You will combine high-level administrative expertise with strong organisational skills to support the agency's leadership team in delivering on Luxinnovation's mission.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire: Representing the leadership and enhancing institutional visibility
• Welcome and accompany VIP visitors, ensuring a professional and seamless experience
• Coordinate internal and external events organised by the CEO's office and the broader leadership team
• Prepare briefing documents, background notes and speaking points for the CEO's external engagements
• Support the CEO's institutional representation at high-level meetings and conferences

Assess & Accelerate: Driving operational excellence across the executive office
• Manage the CEO's diary: schedule appointments, meetings and professional travel (transport, accommodation, programmes, visa formalities where required)
• Process and validate travel-related expense reports
• Collect, consolidate and track information for the CEO on ongoing projects, events and pending requests
• Organise semi-annual and annual performance review meetings between the CEO and direct reports
• Manage and validate leave and telework requests from the CEO's direct reports
• Ensure administrative follow-up: filing, archiving and document management

Connect: Facilitating seamless communication and cross-departmental coordination
• Plan and coordinate leadership meetings: Management Committee (MCM), Staff Meetings, Managers Meetings
• Coordinate across Luxinnovation's departments to ensure fluid communication between the leadership team, staff and external partners
• Manage incoming communications: handle phone calls, emails and relay critical information to the appropriate stakeholders
• Provide ad hoc administrative support to members of the leadership team as needed

Fund: Supporting corporate governance and institutional compliance
• Plan and organise Board of Managers meetings (Conseils de gérance) and General Assemblies
• Prepare corporate governance documents: agendas, attendance lists, proxy forms, General Assembly minutes, official convocations and draft presentations
• Prepare documentation packs and dispatch official convocations and correspondence within statutory deadlines
• Coordinate logistics and room reservations for governance meetings
• Maintain and monitor legal obligations with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion

This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

Required competencies

Education level and professional experience required:
• No specific diploma is required; relevant professional experience is the primary criterion
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in a similar executive assistant, office management or corporate governance coordination role, ideally within a C-suite environment

Specific competencies:
• Demonstrated experience in C-suite diary management and complex travel coordination
• Solid knowledge of corporate governance processes: board meetings, General Assemblies, minute-taking and statutory filings
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
• Strong written and verbal communication skills across multiple stakeholder levels
• High degree of discretion and ability to handle confidential information
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a keen eye for detail
• Experience coordinating cross-departmental workflows and acting as a liaison between leadership and operational teams

Languages:
• Fluent English and French are mandatory
• Luxembourgish or German is a significant asset

IT skills:
• Strong command of the Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
• Very good knowledge and confident use of online tools for travel bookings, reservations, expense management and collaborative platforms

Why choose this position?
This is a unique opportunity to work at the heart of Luxembourg's national innovation agency, directly supporting the leadership team in shaping the country's innovation ecosystem. You will gain first-hand exposure to high-level strategic discussions, corporate governance and cross-departmental coordination. If you want your organisational skills to make a tangible impact, this role offers a genuinely rewarding professional opportunity within a collaborative and forward-looking institution.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their application showing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

• Vous coordonnez les échanges avec les experts techniques, unités IT et bureaux d'études afin de consolider une vision réaliste, sans vous substituer à l'expertise technique
• Vous produisez un aperçu projet exploitable pour le PMO, le management IT, la gouvernance et les sponsors. Vous alimentez le Project Board avec des informations cohérentes, lisibles et traçables, afin de faciliter l'organisation interne, la priorisation et les arbitrages IT
• Vous réalisez des analyses coûts/bénéfices, fiabilisez les éléments financiers et préparez les informations nécessaires à une décision Go / No Go éclairée, en transparence sur les coûts, bénéfices et impacts

Votre profil :      

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de bachelor (bac+3) en informatique
• Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle similaire d'au moins 5 ans
• Vous maîtrisez les langues anglaise et française aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Les langues luxembourgeoise et allemande sont considérées comme un atout
• Vous disposez d'une bonne connaissance de la gouvernance des projets IT et des principes de pilotage de portefeuille (priorisation, arbitrage, décisions Go / No Go)
• Vous maîtrisez le cycle de vie d'un projet IT, depuis le cadrage et l'analyse jusqu'au lancement, à la réalisation et à la mise en production
• Vous comprenez le fonctionnement d'un service Informatique, notamment les rôles du PMO, des unités RUN et BUILD ainsi que des experts techniques
• Vous maîtrisez les méthodes d'analyse et de qualification des demandes, incluant la clarification des besoins, l'identification des enjeux et l'analyse des risques
• Vous connaissez les principes de planification et de gestion des capacités IT, notamment en matière de ressources, de compétences et de dépendances
• Vous maîtrisez les outils de gouvernance et de suivi de projets tels que les Project Boards, les outils PMO et les solutions de reporting
• Vous êtes capable de prioriser et de comparer des projets hétérogènes au sein d'un portefeuille
• Vous faites preuve d'un excellent esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et d'anticipation des risques
• Vous faites preuve d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, adaptées à différents interlocuteurs
• Vous avez la nationalité d'un pays membre de l'Union européenne

Le Groupe CFL, employeur de l'égalité des chances

Au sein du Groupe CFL, nous nous engageons en faveur de l'égalité et de l'inclusion. jobs.title: Data Scientist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Data Scientist (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

As a Data Scientist within the Data Analytics & Governance unit, you will contribute to the development of innovative data products, advanced analytics solutions and AI-enabled capabilities supporting Clearstream Fund Services. Working closely with business, IT, data product and governance teams, you will help transform complex data into valuable insights and scalable solutions that enhance decision-making, operational efficiency and client value across the investment funds industry. The role combines data science, data engineering and analytics, providing opportunities to contribute throughout the entire data lifecycle, from data preparation and modelling to visualization and business adoption.

Your responsibilities:

• Develop and enhance curated datasets, semantic models and analytical data products from requirements gathering through to delivery.
• Build and maintain data pipelines using modern platforms such as Databricks, leveraging SQL, Python and PySpark.
• Design dashboards, reports and self-service analytics solutions using Power BI and related technologies.
• Apply machine learning and AI techniques to develop, test and validate business and operational use cases.
• Support the industrialization and deployment of data and AI solutions in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
• Ensure data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, scalability and performance requirements are embedded throughout the data lifecycle.
• Contribute to Agile delivery activities, including user stories, backlog refinement, stakeholder reviews and solution prioritization.
• Communicate analytical findings, recommendations and technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
• Minimum 2 years of professional experience in data science, analytical solution development, data engineering or related areas.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with hands-on experience using PySpark for data processing and analytics.
• Experience working with Databricks or a comparable modern cloud-based data platform.
• Proven experience developing semantic models, data products and Power BI dashboards.
• Practical experience applying machine learning and AI techniques to business or operational use cases.
• Knowledge of the investment funds industry, fund administration or financial services data environments.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages would be considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Administratif - Agréments (H/F/X) – 40h/sem - CDI - Siège Howald
jobs.description:
a.s.b.l. (anciennement Caritas Jeunes et Familles a.s.b.l.), ci-dessous « CJF », est une association luxembourgeoise forte de ses 38 ans d'engagement dans le secteur social luxembourgeois. Nous comptons plus de 750 collaborateurs répartis sur plus de 40 structures et services et sommes présents dans 19 communes du pays. Nous sommes membres de la Bientraitance a.s.b.l. signifiant que nos actions, projets et postures professionnelles s'inscrivent dans une culture bientraitante et bienveillante. Nous portons notre mission dans chacune de nos actions - Grandir ensemble. Toutes nos actions sont guidées par les principes de la Déclaration universelle des Droits de l'Homme et de la Déclaration des Droits de l'Enfant. Nos collaborateurs travaillent quotidiennement dans les secteurs de l'enfance, de la jeunesse et de la famille afin de créer un environnement serein où chaque enfant, adolescent ou jeune adulte peut trouver toutes les chances de s'épanouir, quelles que soient sa situation et sa différence.

Nous recherchons notre Gestionnaire administratif – Agréments (H/F/X) pour intégrer le service administratif situé au siège à Luxembourg-Howald.

Rattaché à la Direction Administrative et Financière, vous serez amené à :

Vos missions :

• Préparer, constituer et assurer le suivi des dossiers de demande, de renouvellement et de modification d'agréments.

• Assurer la réception et le traitement des appels, des correspondances et des mailings.
• Contribuer à la gestion et à l'organisation des activités courantes du service administratif.
• Assurer une communication régulière et une coordination étroite avec la Direction et les responsables de structures.
• Assurer un rôle de back-up au sein du service administratif afin de garantir la continuité des activités et le suivi des dossiers en cas d'absence. Cette liste de missions, non exhaustive, pourra être adaptée en fonction des besoins ponctuels du service.  

Votre profil :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires.
• Vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine administratif.
• Une expérience similaire dans le secteur public, notamment dans la gestion de dossiers d'agrément, constitue un atout.
• Vous maîtrisez les trois langues du pays : français, luxembourgeois et allemand.

• Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les outils informatiques MS Office. La connaissance d'EduAccueil, Darwin et Platt'form sera appreciée.
• Vous faites preuve de disponibilité et avez le sens des priorités.
• Vous avez la capacité de travailler en équipe.
• Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'organisation, de flexibilité et d'autonomie.
• Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs dossiers en parallèle.  

Nous vous offrons :

• Une rémunération attrayante fixée selon la CCT-SAS en vigueur (Carrière C4 maximum).
• Un environnement de travail bienveillant et professionnel
.• Une culture d'entreprise positive, avec une possibilité d'intégrer une équipe pluridisciplinaire, passionnée et engagée.
• Un contrat à durée indéterminée à Temps Plein (40h/sem).
• Une entrée immédiate ou à convenir.

L'Education est une vocation pour vous ?  

On vous attend ! Rejoindre l'a.s.bl., c'est intégrer une association qui place au cœur de ses actions des valeurs fortes : engagement, ouverture vers l'autre et sa diversité, bienveillance et solidarité.Notre politique d'embauche assure une égalité d'accès aux opportunités pour tous les talents. Toutes les candidatures sont accueillies et évaluées dans un esprit d'équité et de respect. En cas d'embauche, un extrait de casier judiciaire n°3, 4 et 5 vous sera demandé. Elles sont destinées aux membres et aux services de CJF conformément au règlement (UE) 2016/679 du Parlement européen et du Conseil relatif à la protection des données à caractère personnel (RGPD).

jobs.description:
Regulatory Compliance Advisor (m/f/n)

Envie de rejoindre une institution renommée et innovante? Spuerkeess, pilier de la place financière luxembourgeoise avec des notations parmi les meilleures au monde, et employeur de confiance alliant tradition et innovation bancaire depuis 1856, est activement à la recherche d'un nouveau talent.

Département : Compliance
Service : Regulatory Compliance

Vos missions

Dans un environnement réglementaire en constante évolution et toujours plus complexe, notre banque renforce son équipe Compliance et recherche un(e) Regulatory Compliance Advisor. Rattaché(e) à la fonction Compliance, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'analyse, l'interprétation et la mise en œuvre des exigences réglementaires applicables, tout en accompagnant les métiers dans la maîtrise des risques de conformité et le respect des normes en vigueur.

En tant que Regulatory Compliance Advisor, vous interviendrez notamment sur les missions suivantes:

• Conseiller et accompagner les différents métiers et fonctions support dans la mise en œuvre des exigences réglementaires et des politiques internes
• Analyser les textes réglementaires (notamment CSSF, ECB, EBA, gouvernance, crédit, ESG, services d'investissement, paiements, fonds, marchés financiers, …) et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles
• Répondre à toutes les questions des métiers en lien avec le volet réglementaire
• Sensibiliser et former les collaborateurs aux obligations de conformité et aux bonnes pratiques réglementaires
• Contribuer aux projets transverses de la banque impliquant des enjeux réglementaires
• Assurer une veille réglementaire permanente et analyser les impacts des évolutions réglementaires sur les activités de la banque
• Participer à l'élaboration, la mise à jour et le déploiement des politiques, procédures et contrôles de conformité
• Assurer la pérennité du dispositif réglementaire en place
• Contribuer aux analyses de risques de conformité et à la définition des plans d'actions associés
• Faire part des relations avec les autorités de supervision et participer aux réponses lors de demandes réglementaires, inspections ou audits
• Rédiger des avis dans le cadre d'analyses de nouveaux produits ou services, de sous-traitances, ...
• Collaborer avec les autres fonctions de contrôle interne
• Assister et conseiller la direction sur les sujets en lien avec les réglementations

Qualifications requises

• Titulaire d'un Master en droit, finance ou économie
• Expérience professionnelle de 3 à 7 ans minimum dans un rôle similaire, idéalement au sein d'une banque, d'une société de gestion, d'un cabinet de conseil ou d'un régulateur
• Solide connaissance du cadre réglementaire bancaire et financier luxembourgeois et européen
• Bonne maîtrise des exigences réglementaires autres qu'AML/KYC (gouvernance, crédit, ESG, services d'investissement, paiements, fonds, marchés financiers)
• Capacité à analyser des textes réglementaires complexes et à les traduire en solutions pratiques
• Rigueur, esprit d'analyse et sens du détail
• Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration
• Autonomie, proactivité et sens des responsabilités
• Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution
• Maîtrise des langues française et anglaise ; la connaissance de la langue luxembourgeoise constitue un atout

Compétences techniques

L'acquisition de ces compétences peut, sur base de prédispositions d'apprentissage démontrées, être effectuée par l'encadrement et la formation proposée par la Banque au cours de la prise de fonction et la période d'intégration.

Compétences métier

• Connaissance du marché bancaire
• Fonctionnement de la Banque (Spuerkeess)
• Compétences rédactionnelles de notes, reporting et de comptes-rendus
• Produits bancaires
Compétences réglementaires
• Code de déontologie (Code de conduite)

Compétences comportementales

• Adopter une attitude collaborative avec ses interlocuteurs professionnels
• S'inscrire dans une approche client centric faisant de la satisfaction des clients une priorité
• Faire preuve d'ouverture d'esprit face au changement et s'adapter à l'évolution de la banque
• Démontrer de l'engagement et de la passion pour la réalisation de ses missions

Raisons pour rejoindre Spuerkeess :

• Élu employeur le plus attractif au Luxembourg en 2023 selon l'Étude Randstad
• Engagement fort envers la responsabilité sociale et économique
• Conditions salariales attractives avec un statut de droit public assimilé à celui des employés de l'État
• Grande flexibilisation des heures de travail et mode de travail hybride
• Programme d'encadrement personnalisé avec un suivi tout au long de l'intégration

jobs.employer: Amazon Global Store EU S.à r.l.
jobs.description:
Description:

EU Process Engineer AMZL, Standards & Innovation
Job ID: 10529895 | Amazon Global Store EU SarL

Description

This role can be based anywhere in the EU with travel up to 20%. Corporate office locations are in : Munich, Berlin, Madrid, Barcelona, Milan, Paris, Luxembourg, London.
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation. Amazon Logistics aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible.
The European Amazon Logistics team is seeking an experienced, innovative, hands on and customer obsessed Sr Process Engineer to drive standardization and innovation in physical infrastructure, layout and material flow across our Last Mile delivery network. As a member of the EU Amazon Logistics Engineering team you will be responsible for producing and refining process standards, developing new products and processes, building on current best practices for physical infrastructure and designing Amazon Logistics equipment that is used across the EU network and beyond. Infrastructure you develop will always be produced to meet safety, customer experience, capacity, quality and cost goals. You will act as a key point of contact for your area of responsibility within the EU Amazon Logistics processes, frequently partnering with leaders in the field, as well as other operational support functions and your worldwide counterparts. The core process infrastructure ownership element of this role spans Delivery Station under-the-roof and On-the-Road operations.

This position requires deep customer focus, strong autonomy and exceptional project management skills. It will involve regular communication with executors and project sponsors at both the European and worldwide level, and requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable partnering across functional business and technical teams. To be successful in this role, you need to pair strong analytical skills and a data-driven outlook with strong intuition.

Key job responsibilities

• Lead the design and development of new processes, equipment, process-flows, Infrastructure across all processpaths with AMZL
• Optimize existing processes/equipment and drive expansion of new processes/equipment from concept to deployment
• Own and drive programs that improve capacity, productivity, safety and Ergonomics within Delivery Stations
• Author and chair reports/ business case reviews to document project status and changes with senior leadership
• Tracks metrics to identify areas of improvement across all processpaths
• Communicate expansion status/project outputs to senior leaders periodically
• Creates strategy for long term roadmap

A day in the life

Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organization and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short, mid and long term decisions that have impact on a large scale across the AMZL network. You would also be working with partners from Operations, Process Improvement, Health and Safety, Ergonomics, Finance, Procurement and external vendors to design and deploy new equipment and processes for the multiple process paths in AMZL Delivery Stations. You will put in place mechanisms to track project success, measure KPIs and build reports to provide visibility to senior leaders across the organization. Finally, you will have fun doing everything listed above.

About the team

What do we do?
Our team partners closely with AMZL Operations and support functions to identify, design and develop best-in-class process infrastructure and process layouts, and deliver them as EU AMZL network standards. We support prioritization of EU and WW continuous improvement initiatives in addition to cross-regional benchmarking.

Mentorship & Career Growth:
We have a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship. We also care about your career growth, so we assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and grow in their career.

Inclusive Team Culture:
Our team is intentional about building a climate where respect, equity and positive recognition of differences are cultivated as we think it is the best environment to foster innovation.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment, or experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
• Experience in Design/Innovation, research & development, manufacturing, process, industrial engineering, or related work
• Experience in project management
• Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA, or Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
• Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
• Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
• Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

jobs.description:
Description:

Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
• Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
• Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes.
• Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
• Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
• Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.
EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment
• Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
• Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
• Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
• Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.
Automation Hardware Integration
• Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
• Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
• Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
• Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.
Materials Characterization & Testing
• Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies.
• Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
• Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
• Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.
Specifications & Quality
• Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
• Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
• Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards.
• Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.
Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration
• Work directly with EU-based paper mills, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new paper-based packaging materials.
• Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
• Guide suppliers on process optimization—from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations—to achieve target material properties and consistency.
• Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.
Cross-Functional Partnership
• Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
• Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
• Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements (REACH, EU PPWR, CEFLEX).
• Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
• Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
• Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
• Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
• Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
• Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.
This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.
Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.
Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.
What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. jobs.title: Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
Job ID: 10526664 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?
We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.
Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

• Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.
• Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.
• Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.
• Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.
• Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.
• Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.
• Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.
• Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.
• Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About the team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.
Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in program or project management
• Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
• Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
• Experience in Supply Chain Management
• Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
• Experience leading process improvements
• AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
• Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
• Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech
Job ID: 10522151 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promise, across hundreds of millions of packages daily? SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the science behind these decisions. We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Luxembourg (alternatively: Barcelona, or London). You will design and build optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at scale from real-time order assignment and multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to capacity-aware control systems that steer millions of shipments per hour toward operational plans.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization models (MIP, heuristics, decomposition) that solve large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

• PhD
• Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
• Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Unix/Linux
• Experience in professional software development

Freelance or employe LNG Project – Hamburg, Germany – 2 Years

PCT Engineering Resources GmbH is looking for an experienced Welding Engineer / Piping Supervisor for a major LNG construction project in the Hamburg area, Germany.

- Supervise piping fabrication, erection and welding activities on site.

- Participate in site meetings, inspections, audits, walkdowns and punch-list activities.

Mandatory requirements:

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

Fahrzeuglackierer/-in (m/w/d)

Ihre Aufgaben als Fahrzeuglackierer/-in (m/w/d)

- Sie führen fachgerechte Lackierarbeiten an Fahrzeugen und einzelnen Fahrzeugkomponenten durch.
- Sie bestimmen den passenden Farbton und gewährleisten eine präzise Farbtonabstimmung.
- Sie mischen Lacke fachgerecht und wählen geeignete Materialien sowie Produkte aus.
- Sie bereiten Fahrzeuge und Bauteile sorgfältig auf die Lackierung vor – einschließlich Reinigung, Abkleben und Grundieren.
- Sie übernehmen sämtliche abschließenden Arbeiten, darunter Finish, Endkontrolle und Qualitätssicherung.
- Sie unterstützen bei weiteren Aufgaben im Bereich der professionellen Fahrzeuglackierung.

Ihr Profil als Fahrzeuglackierer/-in (m/w/d)

- Sie haben eine Ausbildung zum Lackierer (m/w/d) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Sie überzeugen durch Teamgeist, Zuverlässigkeit sowie einen freundlichen und respektvollen Umgang mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden.
- Dank Ihres ausgeprägten handwerklichen Geschicks arbeiten Sie präzise, sorgfältig und gewissenhaft.
- Ein Führerschein der Klasse B ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

- Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Kein Tag ist wie der andere – bei uns erwartet Sie ein spannendes und vielseitiges Tätigkeitsfeld.
- Wertschätzung & Teamgeist: Wir sind ein familiärer Betrieb, in dem Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden.
- Attraktive Vergütung: Faire und marktgerechte Entlohnung – weil IhreLeistung zählt.
- Sicherheit & Perspektive: Wir bieten dir eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
- Work-Life-Balance: Kostenfreie Parkmöglichkeiten vor Ort und die Möglichkeit, ein JobRad zu nutzen, machen Ihre Alltag noch angenehmer.

Über uns

Wir sind ein modernes Unternehmen, das sich seit Jahren in den Bereichen Karosserie und Lackierung bei unseren Kunden etabliert hat. Seit der Gründung 1990 durch KFZ- und Karosseriebaumeister Helmut Wild entwickelten wir uns zu einem der renommiertesten Fachbetriebe im Kreis Tübingen.

Unser Standort im Industriegebiet Unterer Wert garantiert Ihnen eine schnelle und unkomplizierte Zufahrt aus der Stadtmitte sowie von der B27. Ausreichend Parkmöglichkeiten sind vor Ort vorhanden.

Wir sind ein DEKRA zertifizierter Fachbetrieb, sowie Mitglied im Zentralverband Karosserie- und Fahrzeugtechnik (ZKF).

Als Partnerwerkstatt von führenden Versicherungen wie z.B. HUK-Coburg, Generali, Gothaer, SV, WGV und Württembergische sowie den Vermittlern Innovation Group und Riparo, verfügen wir über das nötige Know-how und Equipment um Reparaturen fachmännisch und herstellerkonform auszuführen.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Pflegedienstleitung / PDL (m/w/d) für die Ambulante Psychiatrische Pflege (APP) (Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Pflegedienstleitung; PDL; Pflegewissenschaften

Stellenbeschreibung:
Die NEUE HILFEN gemeinnützige Unternehmergesellschaft bietet Ambulanten Hilfen für Menschen, als individuelle Hilfestellungen im alltäglichen und lebenspraktischen Bereich. Mit diesen Hilfen unterstützen wir Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können, eine neue Perspektive zu entwickeln. Langfristig verfolgen wir damit das Ziel unsere Kundinnen und Kunden wieder vollständig in die gesellschaftlichen Bezüge einzugliedern. Unsere Dienstleistungen erfolgen in Zusammenarbeit mit Kommunen und Landkreisen.

Im Rahmen unseres neuen Leistungsangebots der Ambulant Psychiatrische Pflege (APP) unterstützen Menschen mit psychischen Erkrankungen in ihrem gewohnten Umfeld. Unser Ziel ist die Stabilisierung der Klienten. Wir wollen Krankenhausaufenthalte verkürzen oder vermeiden. Dafür suchen wir für unser neues Leistungsangebot der Ambulante Psychiatrische Pflege (APP) eine fachlich kompetente und empathische Führungskraft, welche bereits über eine Qualifikation als Pflegedienstleitung verfügt oder eine/n im Gesundheitsbereich bereits fachlich qualifizierte/n Mitarbeitende/n, welche die Qualifikation der Pflegedienstleitung erwirbt.

Ihre Aufgaben als PDL:

- Fachliche Leitung: Organisation und Steuerung des gesamten ambulant-psychiatrischen Pflegedienstes.
- Qualitätsmanagement: Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung der Pflegequalität nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben und MDK-Richtlinien.
- Personalführung: Dienstplanung, Teamentwicklung und fachliche Anleitung der Mitarbeitenden.
- Klientenmanagement: Durchführung von Erstgesprächen, Pflegeplanung und Steuerung des Pflegeprozesses.
- Netzwerkarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit Fachärzten, Kliniken, gesetzlichen Betreuern und Kostenträgern.

Ihr Profil

Sie sind: zuverlässig und belastbar, gehen auf Menschen zu und sind kommunikativ, verfügen über eine positive Grundhaltung, welche Akzeptanz und Empathie auch gegenüber – depressiven, antriebsschwachen oder suchtkranken Menschen beinhaltet, - arbeiten organisiert und scheuen es nicht Schriftverkehr zu führen, - verfügen über ein sicheres Deutsch und einen geschulten Umgang mit Word und Grundkenntnisse in Excel, im Umgang mit PCs und dem Versand von E-Mails.

- Grundqualifikation: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft (z. B. Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in, Altenpfleger/in).
- Zusatzqualifikation PDL (bei Anstellung oder durch Qualifikation im Rahmen der Beschäftigung): Anerguckte Weiterbildung zur Pflegedienstleitung oder ein entsprechendes Studium.
- Führungstalent: Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Organisationsgeschick und ein kooperativer Führungsstil.
- Führerschein: Führerschein der Klasse B ist für die ambulante Arbeit notwendig.

Wir unterstützen Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können, zur Sicherung der gesellschaftlichen Teilhabe. Ziel ist es, unseren Kundinnen und Kunden durch unsere Unterstützung zu ermöglichen, ihren Alltag besser bewältigen und ein weitgehend selbstbestimmtes Leben zu führen.

Häufig ist es für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden schon eine große Hilfe durch unser Angebot eine Bezugsperson mit einem offenen Ohr zu haben.

jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Reinigungspersonal Nutzfahrzeuge

Stellenbeschreibung:
Mitarbeiter für Nutzfahrzeug-Waschanlage (m/w/d) - Vollzeit in Ahlerstedt

Wer wir sind:

Wir sind kein Autohaus mit Hemd und Lackschuhen. Wir sind eine bodenständige Werkstatt in Ahlerstedt an der Basis - nah am Kunden, nah beieinander. Mit 4,9 Sternen bei Google und einer Truppe, die zusammenhält.

Deine Aufgaben:

•  Reinigung von Transportern, Wohnmobilen und Nutzfahrzeugen in unserer Waschhalle

•  Innenreinigung der Fahrzeuge

•  Pflege, Ordnung und Sauberkeit in Werkstatt und Waschhalle

Wen wir suchen:

Wir suchen keine perfekten Lebensläufe. Wir suchen zuverlässige Leute.

•  Du bist pünktlich und man kann sich 100% auf dich verlassen

•  Du hast einen Blick für Ordnung und Sauberkeit - du siehst den Unterschied zwischen schmutzig und sauber

•  Du hast sichere Deutschkenntnisse, weil du auch mal mit unseren Kunden sprichst

•  Du packst mit an, wo Hilfe gebraucht wird

Wer uns hilft die Arbeit zuverlässig zu erledigen, ist unser bester Freund.

Was wir dir bieten:

•  Feste Vollzeitstelle - Montag bis Freitag, Wochenende frei

•  Feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Schichtchaos

•  Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Draht zum Chef

•  Faire Bezahlung, pünktlicher Lohn

•  Eine einfache, ehrliche Truppe wo die Arbeit Spaß macht und kein unnötiger Stress entsteht

•  Arbeitsort: Ahlerstedt

Interesse?

Dann komm einfach vorbei, ruf kurz an oder schick uns eine kurze Nachricht. Langer Bewerbungskram ist nicht nötig.

Werde ein Teil unserer Geschichte...

unsere Geschichte - Hinck Services

Hinck Services ist 2005 ganz klein angefangen.

Als 1-Mann-Betrieb in unserer alten Speditionswerkstatt.

Es wurde mehr und mehr. Mehr Kunden, mehr Arbeit - also auch mehr Mitarbeiter und Auszubildende. Der Kundenstamm ist enorm gewachsen.

2010 haben Torben und Marco Hinck dann den elterlichen Betrieb komplett übernommen.

2011 wurde der jetzige Neubau geplant und 2012 sind wir eingezogen.

2015 wurden wir von Scania angesprochen, ob wir das Stader Gebiet übernehmen wollen. Haben wir gemacht.

2018 kam der nächste Schritt: Anbau für den Transporter- und Neuwagenbereich. Und unsere Prüfstraße wurde komplett neu gebaut - auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik.

2020 haben wir dann Platz geschaffen für unsere Buchhaltung und die Reparaturannahme, mit dem neuen Anbau im Kundenbereich.

Und 2025 kam dann der Vertrag mit Ford dazu, der unseren Transporterbereich noch weiter bereichert.

Was uns freut: Nicht nur unser Kundenstamm wächst ständig, sondern auch unsere Mitarbeiter. Viele sind seit Jahren dabei und erfolgreich mit uns gewachsen.

Wir sind immer noch das, was wir am Anfang waren:

Ein einfacher, bodenständiger Betrieb aus Ahlerstedt, der anpackt.

Nur heute eben etwas größer. Und darauf sind wir stolz.

Familie Hinck

jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (gn) – Infrastruktur (Fachinformatiker/in - Systemintegration)

jobs.description:
Über uns
Jüdisches Krankenhaus Berlin – Ihr Krankenhaus mit Herz!
Das Jüdische Krankenhaus Berlin ist schon seit 270 Jahren für die medizinische und pflegerische Versorgung der Menschen in Berlin da. In der Tradition unseres Hauses achten und respektieren wir jeden Menschen, unabhängig von Religion, Kultur, Herkunft, Hautfarbe, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Geschlecht – das gilt für unsere Patient:innen genauso wie für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Wir lieben und leben Vielfalt! Unsere Mitarbeitenden stammen aus rund 50 Nationen und sind das Fundament unserer Qualität.

Wir sind ein modernes und zukunftsorientiertes Notfallkrankenhaus mit 391 Betten. Bei uns bleiben die Wege kurz, die Hierarchien flach und die Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe – und zwar über alle Teams hinweg. Sei es auf Station, in der Verwaltung oder bei der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Firmen – wir sind engagiert und Qualität ist unser oberstes Gebot.

Im Rahmen der fortschreitenden Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen sowie steigender Anforderungen an die IT-Sicherheit (NIS-2, KRITIS, B3S) und laufender Modernisierungsprojekte suchen wir eine erfahrene Informatikerin bzw. einen erfahrenen Informatiker als IT-Systemadministrator (gn) – Infrastruktur.
