Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro insegnante di classe al doposcuola in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo indeterminato – 2 persone, con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20) e secondo la Decisione sull'organizzazione e sullo svolgimento del doposcuola e della scuola a tempo pieno nelle scuole elementari della Città di Fiume (Gazzetta ufficiale della Città di Fiume n. 4 – anno XII): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA GEOGRAFIJE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 učitelj/učiteljica geografije na talijanskom jeziku na neodređeno i nepuno radno vrijeme (16 sati tjedno), uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku, - presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja. Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: KONOBAR/KONOBARICA
jobs.description:
Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste.  
Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj!  
Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina!  

Što ćete raditi?
- posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima  
- održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme  
- osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu  
- predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama  

Što nudimo?  
- stimulativne uvjete  
- rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki  
- dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu

Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099/497 2236 ili posao@celka.hr.  
Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

jobs.title: Senior Automation Expert (f/m/d) IT/OT Security Platforms (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Together, we make the difference

Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As an Automation Engineer (f/m/d) for IT/OT Security Platforms, you will play a key role in building, automating, and operating the technical foundation of these strategic services. You will work closely with service managers, solution architects, operations teams, and factories worldwide to deliver scalable, automated, and secure solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and industrial digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.
What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .

What part will you play?

- You design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IT/OT Security Platforms (specifically but not exclusively SINEC Secure Connect, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable service operations).- You develop and operate Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation frameworks and support the automated deployment of platforms and services across Siemens factory environments.- You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and automation workflows to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.- You integrate platforms, tools, and services through APIs and automation frameworks to enable seamless operational processes and data flows.- You support the implementation and operation of Zero Trust connectivity solutions and contribute to the automation of policy management, provisioning, and operational workflows.- You collaborate with factories and project teams to integrate solutions into existing IT and OT environments while considering operational requirements and brownfield infrastructures.- You support troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous service improvement activities and help ensure stable operations across global deployments.- You evaluate and leverage modern technologies such as AI-driven automation, analytics, and operational intelligence to continuously improve platform operations and deployment processes.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

What you bring to the table

- You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a comparable qualification.- You possess strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and Platform Automation, including Terraform, Open Tofu, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and automated deployment of connectivity and operations platforms (at least 3+ years of experience).- Scripting/programming skills with Python/Bash/Go.- Proven hands-on experience with Cloud (AWS) and containerized environments and microservices like Docker (at least 2+ years of experience).- You have experience with AI-driven DevOps, Operations and Automation, including the use of LLMs, GitHub Copilot, AIOps concepts, workflow automation, and analytics-driven operational improvements. - You bring hands-on experience in OpenZiti Development (optional) and API Integration (mandatory), including SDKs, REST APIs, policy automation, and custom tooling to integrate Zero Trust networking capabilities into applications and operational workflows. (1+ years of experience).- You have a solid understanding of OT Infrastructure and Industrial Protocols, including PLCs, HMIs, OPC UA, PROFINET, machine-to-machine communication, OT troubleshooting, and the secure integration of solutions into brownfield factory environments. You also understand the emerging role of AI agents in OT environments and the underlying connectivity, security, and operational requirements they introduce.- You possess knowledge of Cybersecurity, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (at least 1+ year of experience).- You are able to bridge IT and OT requirements and collaborate effectively with architects, factory engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders.- You are passionate about automation, standardization, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on reducing manual effort through scalable technical solutions.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Fluent English skills complete your profile. jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

1 Process Engineer (all genders) Job-ID: 203254 I Work Location Model: On-site I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

The impact you'll make
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your roleinvolves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware tomeet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements toensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial roleour customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductorbreakthroughs.

In this role you will directly contribute to panel level processes. This is includes electrochemicalmetal deposition and post plating processes, e.g. metal etching. You will focus on developing process for and with customers around the world and cover smallscale and panel level scale processes.

What you'll do
* Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems
* Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products
* Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields
* Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications
* Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications
* Partner cross-functionally and with customers to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges
* Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap
* Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities

Who we're looking for
Minimum Qualifications:

* Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 6+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years' experience; or equivalent experience
* Good English oral and written communication skills
* Structured and organized working style
* Ability to work independently, high degree of flexibility and capable to work in a crossfunctional environment

Preferred Qualifications:

* In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language
* Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies

* Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD)

* Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization
* Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners
* Experience in semiconductor, process design, deposition, etch dielectrics or conductor, metal films, etc.

jobs.title: Technical Education Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Notion’s product surface expands, we need a builder-teacher who can turn new capabilities into technically accurate education that helps customers confidently build with Notion. In this role, you’ll explore Notion’s newest capabilities, teach by showing, and ship as the product evolves. You’ll be the technical face of Notion Academy: leading workshops, recording walkthroughs, and building implementation guides.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By day 90: Expand Notion’s technical education library. Author technically rigorous Academy content, implementation guides, and Help Center resources that make our most complex capabilities easier to understand and adopt.

 - By day 90: Become a trusted voice for Notion Academy. Teach customers through video, live webinars, and workshops, demonstrating real workflows and solving problems in real time.

 - By day 90: Build with Notion’s newest capabilities. Get hands-on with new product features, use customer insights to identify high-value use cases, and determine top priority workflows for education to focus on.

 - By year one: Reimagine learning with AI. Experiment with adaptive, contextual learning experiences that respond to what customers are trying to build and where they need help.

 - By year one: Prove and scale the impact of technical education. Use product adoption signals to measure impact and improve what we teach, then build reusable standards to help the team deliver effective technical learning faster.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Builder mindset: You learn new product features by getting hands-on, experimenting, and building until you understand.

 - Comfort navigating technical content: you don’t need to write code, but you can read a technical architecture doc, identify what’s outdated, and work with engineers to fix it.

 - Customer-facing credibility: You’re comfortable teaching, building, and troubleshooting in front of customers.

 - AI experimentation: You actively use AI to build, learn, and teach technical proficiency.

 - Product expertise: You can quickly understand a new feature, identify where it creates meaningful customer value, and turn that into practical use cases.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Notion product expertise

 - Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, developer relations, or technical enablement



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $118,000 - $147,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel @ Lassila & Tikanoja
jobs.description:
Hey, you legal generalist with a solution-oriented mindset!

Do you describe yourself as a legal generalist, ideally with in-house experience? Do you have a solid background in corporate and contract law? Are you inspired to join a leading circular economy company working towards a sustainable society?

If you responded **YES**, this position might be for you!

**We are now looking for** a Senior Legal Counsel to join Lassila & Tikanoja. In this role, you will join a compact legal team of two lawyers and support the business with a wide range of legal matters. The position is full-time and permanent. Lassila & Tikanoja's office is located in Helsinki, Pitäjänmäki and you have the opportunity to work remotely in accordance with the company's hybrid working policy.

**Lassila & Tikanoja** is a leading circular economy company committed to unleashing the full potential of circularity together with its customers and partners. It provides waste management and recycling services, hazardous waste treatment and remediation, as well as industrial and water treatment solutions. By turning waste streams into valuable raw materials, L&T reduces environmental impact and promotes a more sustainable, circular society. The company employs approximately 2,300 people in Finland and Sweden and is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.

Find out more about Lassila & Tikanoja at https://www.lt.fi/en/.

**In this role,** you will support the business in negotiating various types of commercial agreements, advice in public tendering processes and support the business in compliance topics, including privacy, by developing instructions, trainings and monitoring. You will also support and advice in questions related to corporate governance, claims, disputes and M&A. You will act as a trusted legal advisor to the business, providing practical, solution-oriented guidance and helping the company navigate legal matters with confidence.

_"We prefer to see sustainability as an opportunity, rather than a threat. We believe that making the world a better place can also be fun." -Jorma Mikkonen, SVP, Public Affairs and Sustainability @ Lassila & Tikanoja_

**We are looking for a lawyer with:**

- A Finnish master's degree in law and at least five years of relevant post-graduate experience (however this is just the minimum requirement, and the role has plenty to offer a more senior lawyer as well) preferably from an in-house legal position or from a law firm or legal consultancy setting.

- A solid background in drafting and negotiating various types of commercial contracts. Prior experience in giving business support in public tendering processes, M&A projects, disputes, compliance, governance, privacy, and/or environmental legal topics are considered as an advanatage.

- A proactive, resilient, and can-do attitude – you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves, take initiative, and get things done.

- A solution-oriented mindset and competence to prioritize assignments - you can give concrete, clear and actionable advice and you are able to adapt to pressure and short deadlines. As a member of a compact legal team, you are expected to work proactively and independently when supporting your key business stakeholders.

- Strong communication skills – fluency in Finnish and English (both written and spoken) is required.


**Lassila & Tikanoja offers you:**

- **A business-oriented position:** If you are a pragmatic and solutions-oriented generalist lawyer who enjoys supporting the business in reaching their goals, this could be your role.

- **Independent legal expert**: You are of course backed up by your colleagues, when necessary, but if you have a rather wide comfort zone where you enjoy operating as an independent legal expert, you could thrive in this role.

- **Room for growth**: At Lassila & Tikanoja, you will find yourself immersed in a constantly evolving environment that provides plenty of opportunities for professional growth and development.


**Interested?** If this sounds like your next career step, please send us your CV and application letter by **21 September 2026**. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Minjon's Senior Recruiter Wilma Tuominen (tel. +358 40 515 3834 or **wilma.tuominen@minjon.fi**).

jobs.title: Service Technieker
jobs.description:
• Leveren, installeren en monteren van meubilair en zorgmateriaal bij onze klanten (woonzorgcentra, ziekenhuizen, thuiszorgwinkels).
  • Onderhouden en herstellen van medisch materiaal, vooral elektrische zorg- en ziekenhuisbedden.
  • Uitvoeren van technische controles en kleine herstellingen.
  • Eerste aanspreekpunt zijn voor klanten en professioneel advies geven.
  • Administratief opvolgen van leveringen, interventies en herstellingen.
  • Voor orde in het magazijn en je bestelwagen zorgen.

Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?

  • Je start in het magazijn, laadt je bestelwagen en vertrekt naar verschillende klanten in België.
  • Je voert montage- en onderhoudswerken uit en lost technische problemen op.
  • Je houdt contact met klanten en beantwoordt hun vragen.
  • Je werkt overdag, zonder weekenddiensten.
  • Technisch aangelegd en praktisch ingesteld
  • Zelfstandig kunnen werken

jobs.title: Student – Verhuurmedewerker
jobs.description:
Wil jij werken in een gezellige en dynamische omgeving? Als student aan de materiaalbalie ben jij hét aanspreekpunt voor klanten die machines huren. Je zorgt voor een vlot en vriendelijk onthaal en beheert de uitgifte en ontvangst van machines. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en klantgerichtheid staan steeds voorop.

Hoe ziet je dag eruit?

  • Klanten ontvangen en te woord staan aan de balie
  • Machines correct uitgeven en retourneren
  • Machines controleren op netheid, veiligheid en werking
  • Toezien op een ordelijke en veilige werkplek
  • Samenwerken met je collega’s als één team

Waarom kiezen voor deze job?

  • Afwisselende taken en veel contact met mensen
  • Je leert bij over technische materialen (ervaring is geen must)
  • Je werkt op zaterdag en in de vakantieperiodes
  • Je draagt écht bij aan een veilige en vlotte verhuurservice

Klaar om de handen uit de mouwen te steken? Solliciteer snel en versterk ons enthousiaste team!

  • Je bent student en beschikbaar op zaterdag en tijdens schoolvakanties
  • Klantgericht, nauwkeurig en verantwoordelijk werken spreekt je aan
  • Je hebt aandacht voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

jobs.title: Technical Engineer | Training & doorgroei
jobs.description:
Heb je ervaring met technisch tekenen en wil je graag doorgroeien? Of ben je een technical engineer die energie haalt uit alles wat met lucht en ventilatie te maken heeft?

Deze stabiele KMO in de regio Kortrijk telt 100+ collega’s, verdeeld over verschillende gespecialiseerde afdelingen. Al meer dan 30 jaar werken ze aan slimme technische oplossingen voor bedrijven die werken met luchtstromen, temperatuurcontrole of geluidsbeheersing. Alles gebeurt onder één dak: van ontwerp tot productie en uitvoering.

In deze functie als Technical Engineer word je de verbindende schakel tussen ontwerp, verkoop en productie. Je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van industriële ventilatoren, analyseert technische vragen en voert verbeteringen door in zowel machines als processen.

Wat houdt de job in?
  • Als Technical Engineer optimaliseer je bestaande ontwerpen en werk je mee aan nieuwe concepten en trillingsanalyses
  • Klantenvragen vertaal je naar sterke technische oplossingen met de juiste berekeningen en ontwerpen
  • Je ondersteunt de productie met interne verbeteringen en slimme hulpmiddelen
  • Je zorgt voor het onderhoud en de optimalisatie van testinstallaties
  • Datasheets, handleidingen en voorschriften volg je nauwgezet op als rechterhand van de productiemanager
  • Je beschikt over een bachelor of master elektromechanica, of gelijkwaardige ervaring
  • Minstens 3 jaar ervaring met technisch tekenen in SolidWorks, Inventor, of gelijkaardige tools
  • Kennis van Nederlands en Frans is belangrijk, gezien veiligheidsinstructies en interne communicatie

jobs.title: Wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij een harde werker met een passie voor infrastructuur? Als wegenwerker speel je een cruciale rol bij de aanleg, herstelling en onderhoud van wegen, voetpaden en andere bestratingen.

Je werkt met diverse materialen zoals asfalt, beton en klinkers en helpt bij het plaatsen van boordstenen, rioleringen en funderingen. Met jouw technische kennis en oog voor detail zorg je ervoor dat elke werf netjes en duurzaam wordt afgewerkt.

Wil je meewerken aan sterke wegen en stevige projecten?

Om onze service sterk te houden zoeken wij versterking in ons team van wegenwerkers.

  • Je voert samen met je team allerlei wegeniswerken uit (rioleringswerken, huisaansluitingen, boordstenen zetten, klinkers plaatsen, ...)
  • Je bent werkzaam in een klein, hecht team
  • Je woont in de omgeving van Wuustwezel
  • Je hebt ervaring in deze sector
  • Je hebt een rijbewijs B

jobs.title: Arbeider wegenwerken
jobs.description:
Hou je van fysiek werk in de buitenlucht? Werk jij graag mee aan projecten waar je later met trots langs kunt rijden?

Als wegenwerker ben je de drijvende kracht achter de aanleg en het onderhoud van wegen, trottoirs en fietspaden. Je werkt met verschillende materialen en machines en zorgt er samen met je team voor dat alles piekfijn in orde is. Of het nu gaat om het plaatsen van boordstenen, het aanleggen van asfalt of het herstellen van een weg, jouw werk zorgt voor veilige en duurzame verbindingen waar iedereen gebruik van maakt.

Klaar om je stempel te drukken op de infrastructuur van morgen?

Je komt terecht bij een aannemer gespecialiseerd in grond-, wegenis-, en rioleringswerken. Het familiebedrijf wordt inmiddels bestuurd door een 3e generatie en is in het bezit van een Vca-certificaat.

Jij kan opgepikt worden regio Beerse. 

  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B
  • Je hebt een eerste ervaring opgedaan in de wegenbouw

jobs.title: Ploegbaas klinkerlegger
jobs.description:
Ben jij iemand die de handen graag uit de mouwen steekt en geniet van het creëren van strakke, duurzame bestratingen? Dan is deze job als ploegbaas klinker- en bestratingswerker precies wat je zoekt!

In deze rol zorg je samen met je team voor de aanleg van terrassen, opritten, parkings en andere bestratingen. Je werkt met diverse materialen zoals klinkers, natuursteen en tegels, en zorgt ervoor dat elke ondergrond perfect wordt voorbereid. Jouw werk legt letterlijk de basis voor projecten waar mensen jarenlang van genieten!

Wij zijn een familiaal bedrijf waar de begrippen degelijkheid, afwerking en kwaliteit zeer hoog in het vaandel worden gedragen. De werken kunnen van zeer dichtbij opgevolgd worden omdat beide patroons dagelijks mee het terrein op gaan. “Ons Motto “ :een klein bedrijf blijven om onze klanten een persoonlijke service te kunnen bieden. Dit is tevens één van onze sterkste troeven om de concurrentiestrijd in onze sector aan te kunnen gaan. 

Ter versterking zoeken wij een ploegbaas/plaatser verhardingen. Dit voor het leggen van: klinkers, kasseien, natuursteen, keramische tegels,... 

  • Voorbereiden van de ondergrond door het egaliseren en aanbrengen van funderingen
  • Plaatsen van klinkers, tegels en boordstenen volgens technische tekeningen
  • Trekken van beddingen
  • Gebruiken van diverse gereedschappen en machines (trilplaten, zaagmachines, ...)
  • Zorgen voor een nette afwerking en naleving van kwaliteitsnormen
  • Samenwerken met collega's om de projecten tijdig klaar te krijgen

Je vertrekt 's ochtends van op het bedrijf, er wordt verwacht dat je hier op eigen krachten geraakt. In de wintermaanden start je om 7u en in de zomermaanden om 6u.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het plaatsen van klinkers. 
  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands. 
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs BE.

jobs.title: Grondwerker
jobs.description:
Zoek je een job als grondwerker / werfarbeider / sleufspecialist? Wij zoeken ervaren bouw arbeiders voor werven in West- en Oost-Vlaanderen!

Werk jij graag in de buitenlucht en hou je van fysiek werk?
Wil je een sleutelrol spelen op de werf en meewerken aan sterke infrastructuurprojecten?
Zoek je een job met afwisseling, verantwoordelijkheid én teamwork? Dan kan dit je interesseren!

Wat ga jij concreet doen?

  • Assisteren bij graafwerken en ondersteunen van de kraanmachinist
  • Voorbereiden en begeleiden van graafwerken, inclusief proefsleuven
  • Plaatsen van stutten en schoren voor veilige uitvoering

  • Actief bijdragen aan een vlot verloop van de werkzaamheden
  • Je beschikt over een geldig rijbewijs B
  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands

jobs.title: Arbeider klinker- en wegenwerken
jobs.description:
Heb jij oog voor strakke bestrating en een passie voor wegenbouw?
Dan is dit je kans om te werken bij een dynamisch bedrijf dat al meer dan 30 jaar dé specialist is in de sector. Hier draag je bij aan indrukwekkende projecten en werk je samen met een hecht en professioneel team. Of je nu bezig bent met openbare werken, particuliere opdrachten of industriële projecten – jouw werk laat overal een blijvende indruk achter.

Wat ga je doen:
Jij krijgt een afwisselend takenpakket, waarbij geen dag hetzelfde is. Denk aan:

  • Het leggen van bestrating en aansluiten van straatkolken.
  • Het plaatsen van rioleringen en maken van funderingen.
  • Het uitvoeren van grondwerken, zoals het uitgraven en opnieuw aanleggen van bestrating.
  • Het plaatsen van draadafsluitingen.
  • Ervaring hebt in het leggen van klinkers.
  • Een rijbewijs B op zak hebt.
  • Fit en fysiek sterk bent.

jobs.title: Wegenwerker afwerking
jobs.description:
Klinkers, dallen, borduren, je kent ze allemaal en kan ze ook plaatsen alsof het niets is?  Onze ploeg staat in voor de afwerking van wegenwerken en wij zoeken een extra collega!

Je wordt dagelijks opgehaald door de ploegbaas op een vaste opstapplaats dicht in je buurt. 

Jij zal voornamelijk werken in de regio Beerse, Turnhout, Oud-Turnhout

  • Je hebt reeds een werk gerelateerde functie uitgeoefend
  • Je bent flexibel naar start en stop uren
  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands

jobs.title: Chefkok
jobs.description:
Misschien is het tijd voor meer.

Meer ruimte om te creëren.
Meer verantwoordelijkheid.
Meer van jezelf in wat er op het bord komt.

BLEUET zoekt een chef-kok.

We hebben geen chef nodig die enkel de service draaiende houdt. We zoeken iemand die vooruit wil. Iemand met smaak, techniek en een eigen blik. Die een team kan meenemen, rust brengt wanneer het vuur aangaat en begrijpt dat eenvoud vaak het moeilijkste is.

Bij BLEUET stap je niet in een vaststaand verhaal. Je bouwt eraan mee.

Samen met chef-eigenaar Pieter-Jan krijg je een bepalende rol in de keuken. Van de eerste ideeën en de keuze van het product tot het moment waarop het gerecht aan tafel verschijnt. Je bewaakt het dagelijkse niveau, stuurt het team aan en krijgt de vrijheid om ook zelf culinair je stempel te drukken.

We groeien, verfijnen en willen sterker worden — als restaurant én als team. Daar zoeken we iemand voor die dezelfde honger voelt.

Iemand die:

  • gastronomische ervaring en een sterke technische basis heeft;
  • leiding kan geven zonder voortdurend op de voorgrond te staan;
  • kritisch is voor zichzelf en zorg draagt voor het team;
  • creativiteit kan vertalen naar een haalbare, constante service;
  • verantwoordelijkheid niet afwacht, maar vastneemt;
  • samen met ons wil bouwen aan wat BLEUET nog kan worden.

In ruil krijg je geen plek in de schaduw, maar vertrouwen, inspraak en echte verantwoordelijkheid. Een keuken met ambitie, sterke producten en ruimte om te groeien. De verloning en voorwaarden stemmen we af op jouw ervaring en de rol die je kunt opnemen.

Je hoeft niet actief op zoek te zijn om te voelen dat dit bij je past.

Kom kennismaken. Proef onze keuken, ontmoet het team en vertel ons waar jij naartoe wilt.

BLEUET · Maarkedal
allthingsbleuet.be

Je spreekt Nederlands, Engels of Frans.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer | 80% reizen
jobs.description:
Zit techniek in je vingers en droom je van buitenlandse projecten vol afwisseling en uitdaging? Dan is dit absoluut iets voor jou.

Voor een groeiende machinebouwer in de omgeving van Oostkamp, actief binnen de voedingsindustrie, zoeken we een Field Service Engineer die houdt van techniek en internationale verplaatsingen. Deze West-Vlaamse KMO is wereldwijd gekend voor haar totaaloplossingen: van ontwerp en bouw tot plaatsing en onderhoud van hoogtechnologische machines.

Hier stap je binnen in een bedrijf waar de koffie warm is, de collega’s meedenken en kwaliteit altijd vooropstaat. Binnen het serviceteam krijg je bovendien alle kansen om te groeien, zowel op technisch vlak als in je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Wat houdt de job in?
  • Als service ingenieur sta je in voor de installatie van machines bij klanten wereldwijd, en dat na een grondige interne opleiding
  • Tot 80% van je tijd breng je door op locatie, vooral binnen Europa
  • Ter plaatse zorg je voor een volledige opstart van de machines, zowel mechanisch, elektrisch als pneumatisch
  • Je geeft duidelijke uitleg en begeleidt medewerkers zodat zij zelfstandig met de installaties kunnen werken
  • Bij technische storingen ga je ter plaatse, analyseer je de oorzaak en bied je een doeltreffende oplossing
  • Bij voorkeur genoot je een hoger, technisch diploma binnen Elektromechanica (of Bachelor Elektromechanica met een sterke hands-on mentaliteit, opgebouwd via technische vakantiejobs, projecten of hobby’s)
  • Ook deed je al praktische ervaring op via een stage, vakantiejob of een gelijkaardig traject
  • Je bent bereid om tot 80% van je tijd in het buitenland te werken
  • Sterke Nederlandse & Engelse talenkennis omwille van veiligheid & communicatie

jobs.title: PLC-Automation Engineer | Machinebouw
jobs.description:
Wil jij PLC-besturingssystemen programmeren voor machines die wereldwijd hun weg vinden naar klanten? Lees dan zeker verder!

Deze West-Vlaamse KMO uit regio Roeselare telt een vijftigtal medewerkers en groeide doorheen de jaren uit tot een gevestigde speler binnen de machinebouw. Kwaliteit, betrouwbare samenwerkingen en technische expertise vormen er de rode draad. Door de aanhoudende groei investeert de organisatie verder in de optimalisatie en professionalisering van haar interne processen, en daarom is ze op zoek naar een gedreven PLC-Automation Engineer om het team te versterken.

Wat houdt de job in?
Als automatisatie-ingenieur ben je verantwoordelijk voor het programmeren, implementeren en optimaliseren van geavanceerde automatiseringssystemen voor de machines van de organisatie.
  • Je programmeert PLC-besturingssystemen en HMI-displays, rekening houdend met operationele doelstellingen en klantspecifieke eisen
  • Daarnaast test, valideer en finetune je software en hardware om optimale prestaties te garanderen
  • Bovendien werk je binnen vastgestelde projectbudgetten en streef je steeds naar kosteneffectieve oplossingen
  • Verder brief je de service engineers die instaan voor de implementatie en inbedrijfname van de machines bij de klant
  • Tot slot sta je in voor troubleshooting en het oplossen van technische problemen, telefonisch of ter plaatse bij de klant
  • Je behaalde minstens een Bachelordiploma Elektromechanica of gelijkwaardig
  • Kennis van PLC-sturingsprogramma's is vereist, mocht je ervaring hebben Omron CX-Programmer en Sysmac Studio dan is dit een grote troef, maar deze talen worden sowieso aangeleerd intern
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels
  • Bovendien kijk je ernaar uit om af en toe naar het buitenland te reizen voor service bij (internationale) klanten (max. 1 à 2 opeenvolgende nachten)

jobs.title: wegenwerker  regio geel
jobs.description:
Wegenwerker Regio Geel

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Ben jij niet bang om je handen vuil te maken en houd van buiten werken? Dan ben jij misschien wel onze nieuwe wegenwerker! Samen met je collega's vorm je een sterk team en zorg je voor:

  • Plaatsen van rioleringen, funderingen en boordstenen
  • Het graven van sleuven en putten
  • Het plaatsen van kabels en leidingen
  • Het aanleggen van verschillende soorten bestratingen

Elke dag kom je tot aan de opstapplaats in Geel, vanwaar je samen met je collega's naar de werf vertrekt.



PROFIEL

Ben jij degene die altijd in actie schiet en geen uitdaging uit de weg gaat? Dan ben jij de persoon die we zoeken.

Wij zoeken iemand die:

  • Een eerste ervaring heeft in de wegenwerken
  • Praktisch ingesteld is en van aanpakken weet
  • In het bezit is van rijbewijs (je bestuurt de camionette)
  • Goed in het Nederlands communiceert
  • De veiligheidsregels volgt

Afin de renforcer son équipe commerciale et de poursuivre son développement sur le marché français, nous recherchons un Internal Account Manager.

Pas de vente agressive, ni de simple service client. Vous prenez des initiatives, créez de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et accompagnez vos clients tout au long de leurs projets. Vous devenez ainsi leur interlocuteur privilégié, de la première prise de contact jusqu'à la réalisation du projet.


En tant qu'Internal Account Manager, vous combinez développement commercial et suivi de projets de A à Z :

  • Développer activement de nouvelles opportunités commerciales sur le marché français

  • Suivre l'avancement de la production et contribuer à la coordination du transport

Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité commerciale, proactive et orientée client, capable de prendre des initiatives tout en gardant une vue d'ensemble sur ses projets :

  • Une maîtrise du français proche du niveau langue maternelle, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit
