jobs.title: Public Sector Strategic Account Executive, Federal Civilian
Duty Manager Passenger Assistance (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Duty Manager Passenger Assistance (m/f/x)

Missions :

Assurer la préparation des opérations et la planification journalière des ressources nécessaires à l'activité
Contrôler le respect du planning et enregistrer les changements de personnel selon les procédures en vigueur. Selon les besoins de l'opération et les requêtes individuelles procéder aux ajustements du planning à court terme
Transmettre l'information et les directives nécessaires aux équipes du Ground Handling pour le bon déroulement des opérations et suivre les statuts des vols afin d'anticiper toute éventualité
Etre l'interlocuteur privilégié avec les autres services ainsi qu'avec les représentants des compagnies tierces
Signaler toute irrégularité et établir le srapport quotidien de fin de tournée
Proposer des actions correctives afin d'améliorer la qualité du service
Etre en étroite collaboration avec le Manager Passenger Assistance afin de participer au développement et suivi des ressources. Coordonner les besoins spécifiques/individuels avec le département Formation
Gérer les irrégularités du réseau Luxair et LuxairTours au départ et à l'arrivée de toutes les stations desservies en collaboration avec l'OCC et coordonner les plans d'actions avec les équipes et prestataires concernés
Rapporter toute anomalie à la Direction du Ground Handling

Profil requis:

Critères minimaux requis pour le poste

Etre détenteur d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires au Luxembourg ou équivalent
Maîtriser l'anglais, le français et/ou l'allemand (parlé & écrit)
Etre orienté clients, avoir une présentation soignée et respecter les procédures du port d'uniforme
Avoir une expérience confirmée de l'Assistance Passager ainsi que de l'encadrement d'équipes opérationnelles
Maintenir la stricte confidentialité des données
Etre précis, avoir le sens de l'organisation et des priorités et une grande résistance au stress
Savoir travailler de manière autonome et en équipe
Travail sur tournées
Le luxembourgeois et toute autre langue sera considérée comme un atout majeur à ce poste

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Profile

Ensure the preparation of operations and the daily planning of the resources required for the activity.
Monitor compliance with the schedule and record staff changes in accordance with the applicable procedures. Based on operational requirements and individual requests, make short-term adjustments to the schedule as necessary.
Communicate the information and instructions required by the Ground Handling teams to ensure the smooth running of operations, and monitor flight statuses in order to anticipate any potential issues.
Act as the main point of contact with other departments as well as with representatives of third-party airlines.
Report any irregularities and prepare the daily end-of-shift report.
Propose corrective actions to improve service quality.
Work closely with the Passenger Assistance Manager to contribute to the development and monitoring of resources.
Coordinate specific and individual needs with the Training Department.
Manage irregularities affecting the Luxair and LuxairTours network, both on departure and arrival at all stations served, in cooperation with the OCC, and coordinate action plans with the relevant teams and service providers.
Report any anomalies to Ground Handling Management.

Minimum Requirements

Hold a Luxembourg secondary school leaving diploma or an equivalent qualification.
Have a good command of English, French and/or German, both spoken and written.
Be customer-oriented, maintain a professional appearance and comply with uniform-wearing procedures.
Have proven experience in Passenger Assistance as well as in supervising operational teams.Maintain strict confidentiality of information and data.
Be accurate, well-organised, able to prioritise effectively and highly stress-resistant.
Be able to work both independently and as part of a team.
Be willing to work shifts.
Luxembourgish and any other additional language will be considered a major asset for this position.

Champion the effective and secure use of AI to support automation, efficiency, and scalable risk management practices.

8+ years of experience in cyber, technology, or ICT risk, with a strong understanding of second line oversight, control effectiveness, and independent challenge.
Experience in a highly regulated environment, ideally in financial services, including interaction with regulatory expectations and governance processes.

Strong knowledge of relevant ICT and cyber regulatory requirements, including DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act, CSSF expectations, and related European frameworks.

Ability to assess complex technology and security risks, provide practical challenge to first-line teams, and influence outcomes across business and technical stakeholders.
Experience in business continuity, identity and access management, secure software development.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC are strongly preferred; ISO 27001, ISO 22301, or similar certifications are a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively across functions.

jobs.title: Senior People & Talent Operations Partner
jobs.description:
â¡ This one's going to move fast. We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. Applications and assessments close September 20, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that.Â 

ð Where do we hire from? Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page. For this role, you'll have at least 4 hours daily overlap with your UK-based manager.

Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â  Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  • Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

  • Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

  • Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

  • Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

  • Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

  • Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

  • Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

  • Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

  • Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

  • Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

  • Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

  • Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

  • Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

  • Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

  • Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

  • HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

  • Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

  • Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

  • Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

  • Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
    *Check out the countries we currently hire from here.

  • Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

  • Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

  • Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

  • Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA GEOGRAFIJE
jobs.description:

  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 2) 1 insegnante di geografia – 14 ore settimanali, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20); 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tallinnas on kümneid ja kümneid töökodasid (Sa tead ju küll neid büroohoone kümnendal korrusel keerates vasakule ja paremale ja korruse lõpus asuvaid "ilusalonge"), milleks Sulle see? Salongi lahendus - Ilustuudio Mariell Tallinnas on jagatud kolmeks poolkorruseks, ehk et igal iluteenindajate grupil on enda privaatsus, föönid ei sega kosmeetiku tööd ega ripsmeid ei pea paigaldama varbad küünetehniku silme ees 😉

PhD Candidate in Laser-Induced Graphene (LIG) Sensors for Composite Materials
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We have a new vacancy for a 3-year PhD position at ASEMlab, NTNU Gjøvik, funded by Horizon Europe projects. The PhD candidate will work with NTNU's laser-induced graphene (LIG) sensing line developing a LIG sensor system for in-situ process monitoring of fibre reinforced composite systems, and maturing it from lab-scale prototypes to integration in demonstrators. The LIG system will be developed and benchmarked alongside complementary sensing technologies. This is a doctorate at the intersection of functional 2D materials, printed electronics, industrial composites manufacturing and structural health monitoring.

The position is hosted by ASEMlab – the Laboratory of Advanced and Sustainable Engineering Materials (www.asemlab.no) at the Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, NTNU – Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Gjøvik campus. ASEMlab performs research on polymers and composite materials across their full life cycle: advanced manufacturing, structural health monitoring and sensing, non-destructive evaluation, durability and ageing, recycling and circularity, and sustainability assessment. The laboratory operates extensive infrastructure including manufacturing, sensor development, laser systems, thermal and physico-chemical analysis (DMA, TGA, FTIR, dielectric spectroscopy), mechanical and thermomechanical fatigue testing, accelerated ageing facilities, micro-CT, CMM, ultrasound imaging, etc.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • design and fabricate laser-induced graphene sensors and sensor arrays (temperature, strain, pressure) using ASEMlab's laser-processing infrastructure
  • characterise and calibrate the sensors electromechanically, structurally, thermally, morphologically, etc., using advanced analytical techniques, and benchmark them against complementary sensing technologies (e.g. fibre optics)
  • develop the LIG sensor system for process monitoring and structural health monitoring
  • implement the data-acquisition chain and data-import protocols as well as analyze sensor data for different needs 
  • Work closely with interdisciplinary teams of internal and external researchers specializing in sensor technologies, materials science, data analytics, etc.
  • analyze data and publish results in leading international journals and present at conferences, contribute to project deliverables, training workshops and dissemination activities

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in materials science/engineering, electronics/mechatronics, applied physics, nanotechnology, mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • demonstrated hands-on experience working in a research laboratory environment, including the safe handling of chemicals and operation of scientific instrumentation
  • strong foundational understanding of solid-state physics/chemistry and materials characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy, SEM, or XRD)
  • hands-on experimental skills within sensors or functional/printed materials
  • very good written and oral English skills (documented per NTNU requirements for non-native speakers)
  • proven ability to work independently, manage a research project timeline, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • experience in the design, fabrication, or characterization of electromechanical sensors, printed/flexible sensors, or graphene/2D and carbon-based functional materials 
  • hands-on experience with laser synthesis, laser micromachining, or optical systems, including CO₂ or UV laser platforms commonly used for LIG fabrication
  • experience with electronics prototyping, instrumentation and data acquisition tools (Python, LabVIEW), electrical characterization hardware (e.g., source meters, potentiostats, impedance analyzers) and basic signal processing, while interest in machine-learning-based process control is a plus
  • knowledge of fibre-reinforced polymer composites and their manufacturing processes
  • experience with electrical/electromechanical characterisation techniques (e.g. impedance spectroscopy, DIC-coupled strain sensing)
  • willingness to travel for test and demonstration campaigns for project needs in Europe 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • proactive, self-driven, structured and rigorous in experimental work
  • collaborative and team-oriented mindset suited to a university lab and a large industrial consortium with firm deadlines
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • curiosity and ambition to publish at a high international level

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in an international, EU-funded project consortium
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Science Doctoral Programme - PhD - Faculty of Engineering Science - NTNU within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who, by assessment of the application and attachments, are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.

Please note that the candidate holding the announced position is expected to work with critical infrastructure and areas subject to controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology. Candidates with the potential of not fulfilling the requirements for security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the Act Relating to National Security, the Export Control Act and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered for the position.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates/diplomas (BSc and MSc) with grade transcripts; diplomas in other languages must be accompanied by certified English translations
  • a motivation letter (max 2 pages) describing your suitability for and interest in the position
  • MSc thesis (or a draft if not yet completed) and any publications or other relevant research output
  • documentation of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL) where applicable
  • names and contact details of at least two referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Sotirios Grammatikos, Director of ASEMlab, Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, NTNU Gjøvik. E-mail: sotirios.grammatikos@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no 

Application deadline: 18.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

Requirements

 - Currently based in Europe.

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Lead, mentor, and support senior designers, with a focus on growth, feedback, and long-term career development

Partner with the Game Design Director to evolve and uphold EVE Online’s design process

Extensive experience with gameplay systems and live game design, with the ability to give high-quality feedback
Clear, empathetic communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills
Experience shipping features in live service, MMO, sandbox, or similarly complex products

Bonus Experience: Familiarity with EVE Online, sandbox games, or player-driven economies

The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation

jobs.title: Join a GP practice in Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Imagine combining a rewarding medical career with breathtaking nature, short commuting distances, and a healthier work-life balance.

On behalf of a municipality on the Helgeland coast in Northern Norway, we are seeking a family medicine specialist to join a well-established primary care centre. This permanent position offers the opportunity to work in a supportive professional environment while enjoying life in a welcoming coastal community surrounded by mountains and the sea.

About the position

You will become part of an organised and collaborative healthcare environment with experienced GPs, resident doctors, and other healthcare professionals working closely together. The medical centre is co-located with other municipal health services, providing efficient collaboration and short decision-making processes.

Your responsibilities will include:

    General practice consultations and patient list responsibility
    Diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Participation in out-of-hours emergency services on a rotational basis
    Collaboration with municipal healthcare services and specialist care providers

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Competitive and attractive salary conditions
    Excellent working conditions and a supportive professional environment
    Opportunities for professional development and further training
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    A varied and rewarding workday in beautiful natural surroundings
    A stable workplace with a strong focus on quality and collaboration

Free Norwegian language training

We understand that relocating to a new country is a major step. Therefore, we provide:

    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process
    Guidance and assistance with relocation
    Help with integration into both the workplace and local community

About the municipality

The municipality is located on the spectacular Helgeland coast in Northern Norway, an area known for its dramatic landscapes, beautiful archipelagos, mountains, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities. The municipal centre offers a wide range of services, cultural activities, sports facilities, and excellent conditions for families. Residents enjoy a safe and friendly community with easy access to nature and a high quality of life.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

Norway offers a well-functioning public healthcare system where GPs play a key role in the long-term follow-up of their patients. Doctors benefit from a high degree of professional autonomy, collaborative working environments, and a healthcare culture built on trust and quality of care.

Norway is also known for its strong focus on work-life balance, making it possible to combine a rewarding medical career with family life, outdoor activities, and personal interests.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and the municipality. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Move to Norway and work as a nurse in Rogaland

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment together with nurses, doctors, healthcare assistants and other healthcare professionals, with a strong focus on good patient pathways, cooperation and quality of care, and where a positive and supportive working atmosphere is an important part of everyday life.

    Observation, assessment and documentation of patients’ health conditions
    Medication management and treatment according to guidelines
    Cooperation with doctors, colleagues, patients and relatives

You will join a well-organised service with experienced colleagues, clear routines and good professional support.

We are looking for nurses who:

    Hold a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country

jobs.title: Flytta till Barcelona i vinter!
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av mobila bredbandsabonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Nurses wanted for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?

On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.

Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.

At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.

About the position

As a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.

Typical responsibilities include:

    Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care
    Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions
    Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations
    Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams
    Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathways

The position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.

    Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country
    Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian
    Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting
    Valid driver’s licence (Class B)
    Professionally engaged and responsible
    Strong teamwork and adaptability skills
    Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantage

We offer

    Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions
    Free Norwegian language training provided
    A stable and predictable working environment
    Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities
    A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed
    Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP
    Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work
    Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process
    Support with housing and relocation when needed

Life in Snåsa

Snåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.

For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.

Interested?

Feel free to contact us for more information or submit a short application today!

jobs.title: Team Leader Nurse Team
jobs.description:
Lead a Team of Registered Nurses Providing Medical Assistance Worldwide

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

The position will be based at Viking Travel Care in Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain.

Working Hours

The role follows the Team Leader rotation and includes day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts, with flexibility needed to support a 24/7 operation when required.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Deadline

Please apply before September 30th

jobs.title: Kokenut tarjoilija
jobs.description:
**Tarjoilija, tuukko töihin?**

Etsimme tiimiimme kokemusta jo kerännyttä tarjoilijaa, jolla pysyy käsissä niin useampi AC lautanen, bricka, lisämyynti, baarilusikka kuin isot ryhmät!

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja on viikonloppupainotteista. Tunteja tarjolla noin 50h/3vk, eli mainio lisäduuni!

Meillä pääset tekemään tarjoilijan työtä laajasti; arkisin lounasbuffet, iltaisin ja viikonloppusin A la carte ja lisäksi teemme tilaustarjoilua yhteistyökumppaneille. Meitä Pancholaisia yhdistää rennon rempseä ote työhön, hyväntuulisuus ja huumori niin työkavereiden kuin asiakkaiden kesken, ammattitaitoa ja rautaista asiakaspalvelua sekä myyntiä tietenkään unohtamatta.

Meillä tehdään töitä seuraavien arvojen mukaisesti: Lämmöllä, vahvuuksilla, huumorilla, kannattavasti! Miksi kannattaisi hakea? Nokian Pancho on saavuttanut erittäin hyvät arvosanat ja maineen. Työntekijät kertovat viihtyvänsä meillä erityisesti hyvän työyhteisön ansiosta. Nokian Pancholla pääset nuorekkaaseen, erityisen hyväntuuliseen ja yhteen hiileen puhaltavaan työyhteisöön. Työaika ja palkkaus sovitaan yhdessä. Ole rohkeasti yhteydessä. Voit soittaa tai voidaan sopia tapaaminen mikäli haluat kysyä lisää paikasta.

Hygieniapassi ja anniskelupassi vaaditaan.

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi ja mieluiten myös Cv:n osoitteeseen ida.lehtinen@panchovilla.fi. Paikka pyritään täyttämään ja perehdytys aloittamaan asap. Lisää meistä ja meidän arjesta löydät someistamme: Instagram @panchovillanokia TikTok @maajaiska

jobs.title: Vikarlærere søges til udskolingen i København V
jobs.description:
På vegne af en skole i København V søger FIRMAVIKAR to engagerede vikarlærere til længerevarende vikariater i udskolingen med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Matematiklærer

Vi søger en matematiklærer til et vikariat på ca.6 måneder.

Stillingen kan tilpasses både deltid og fuldtid afhængigt af kandidatens profil og tilgængelighed. Ved et godt samarbejde kan der være mulighed for forlængelse eller efterfølgende fastansættelse.

Fysiklærer

Derudover søger vi en fysiklærer til et længerevarende vikariat på ca. 1 år.

Også denne stilling kan være både på deltid og fuldtid. For den rette kandidat kan der være mulighed for fastansættelse efter vikariatet.

Vi søger dig, som

  • Har erfaring med undervisning i udskolingen

  • Har stærke faglige kompetencer inden for matematik eller fysik

  • Er stabil, engageret og god til at skabe struktur i undervisningen

  • Kan indgå naturligt i skolens eksisterende team

  • Har gode danskkundskaber i både tale og skrift

Det er en fordel, hvis du er læreruddannet eller har relevant undervisningserfaring, men vi hører også gerne fra kandidater med anden relevant faglig baggrund.

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: København V
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt
Omfang: Deltid eller fuldtid
Varighed:
Matematik: ca.6 måneder
Fysik: ca. 1 år

Begge stillinger har mulighed for forlængelse og eventuel fastansættelse ved det rette match.

Er du interesseret, er du meget velkommen til at sende dit CV samt en kort beskrivelse af din erfaring og tilgængelighed til FIRMAVIKAR.

jobs.title: Fast flyttearbejder søges til boligstylingsfirma i Albertslund
jobs.description:
Vi søger en stabil flyttearbejder til et længerevarende vikariat hos et boligstylingsfirma i Albertslund.

Du bliver en del af et fast team og får en alsidig hverdag med flytteopgaver, kørsel, lagerarbejde og forskellige praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med boligstyling.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Almindelige flytteopgaver

  • Kørsel med liftbil

  • Lastning og aflæsning

  • Hjælp på lageret efter behov

  • Praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med boligstyling

  • Ophængning af billeder, vægkunst og lamper

  • Øvrige forefaldende praktiske opgaver

Det er en fordel, hvis du allerede har erfaring med lettere ophængning og montage, men det er ikke et krav, da der er mulighed for oplæring.

Vi søger dig, som

  • Har kørekort og erfaring med kørsel med liftbil

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har et godt fysisk helbred og trives med fysisk arbejde

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå godt i et team

  • Gerne har erfaring med flyttearbejde, lager eller lignende

  • Gerne har erfaring med ophængning af billeder, vægkunst og lamper

Du vil indgå i teamet sammen med 2 faste flyttearbejdere samt boligstylister efter behov.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdstid: Mandag til fredag kl. 08.00–15.30

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt
Varighed: Længerevarende vikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse ved det rette match

jobs.title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. jobs.title: Phd Research Fellow in Medicinal Chemistry
jobs.description:
About the position

As part of the HARPNET Doctoral Training Network we invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in Medicinal Chemistry available at the Department of Pharmacy, University of Oslo. 

Starting date no later than April 1, 2027. 

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is Department of Pharmacy, the Life Science Building, Blindern, Oslo

About the network
HARPNET is a Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network that prepares 15 doctoral candidates to transform how chronic inflammatory diseases are understood and treated. HARPNET’s scientific programme is integrated across three scientific work packages, where data, technologies and biological models will be shared across projects through joint supervision, network activities and academic and industrial secondments. The position is allocated to work-package 3 Developing therapeutic and translational solutions within the HARPNET network.

We are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our team at the Uni-versity of Oslo for the project:

DC12 - Small-molecule promoters of inflammation resolution

Supervisor Trond Vidar Hansen: https://www.mn.uio.no/farmasi/english/people/aca/trondvh/index.html


Project description

This project aims to develop low-molecular-weight resolution promoters targeting GPR101 as potential therapies for rheumatoid arthritis. Computational experiments will guide compound design, synthesis, and biological evaluation, including the assessment of bioactivity, mechanisms of action, medicinal chemistry properties, and metabolism.

The work will be conducted in close collaboration with research groups across the network working on resolution biology and drug discovery based on resolution pharmacology. The position also include internships with both academic and industrial partners, and the doctoral candidate must participate in these activities.

Methods will include synthetic medicinal chemistry, chromatography, spectroscopic and analytical techniques (HPLC, LC-MS, and GC), as well as computational tools. An integral part of the work will be the integration of biological data with medicinal chemistry principles to identify the most promising molecular candidates.


How to apply

Technical information:

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 1st, 2026
Interviews: Online during the period October 19th – November 6th and in presence Friday 4th December 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application: 
https://harpnet.eu/recruitment/

Apply for position DC12; we recommend applying for multiple positions within the network.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in synthetic medicinal chemistry or synthetic organic chemistry. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented solid experience in synthetic organic chemistry
  • Documented solid experience in chromatography, spectroscopy and analyses of low molecular organic compounds
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented relevant experience in lipid chemistry
  • Documented relevant experience in medicinal chemistry oriented computational tools
     

University of Oslo is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

We are an international team of researchers from diverse scientific and cultural backgrounds, and we seek a candidate with these personal skills:

  • Good language and communication skills
  • Good collaboration skills
  • The ability to work in interdisciplinary teams
  • The ability to work independently on complex projects, from planning to presenting results
  • The ability to work precisely in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods
     

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.


General eligibility criteria for the HARPNET network
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet all eligibility criteria as outlined in the individual research projects descriptions
  • Candidates must meet the entry requirements for admission to the PhD-program of the institution to which they apply, see below for more details

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD pro-gramme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the Grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7

The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 610 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


General information

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Pharmacy has 130 employees. We have an active research and innovation environment based on independent research in pharmaceutical topics. The Department of Pharmacy is responsible for the popular master's degree program in pharmacy and has 350 competent and committed students.
Pharmaceutical related research and education forms the base of all activities at the Department of Pharmacy. The science of pharmacy lies in the interface between the natural sciences, pharmaceutical technology, health related topics and social sciences. This interdisciplinarity is reflected both in our study programmes and in our research. 
 

In the planned life science building at the University of Oslo, closer collaboration with health enterprises, local government and the business sector will enhance quality and relevance in research and education of the future labour force. The building will be the heart of the first innovation district in Norway – Oslo Science City. The Department of Pharmacy will move into the new Life Science building in 2026.
