jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.



We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.



You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 


SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.



NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - A background in IT engineering, SRE, or production engineering that transitioned into security engineering.

 - Experience building internal security tooling or workflows that improved employee or developer experience.

 - Contributions to the security community through open-source tools, blog posts, or conference talks.

 

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Sukladno Kolektivnom ugovoru Sveučilišta u Zagrebu-Studentskog centra u Zagrebu, za navedeno radno mjesto ugovara se probni rad u trajanju od dva (2) mjeseca.
Prijavu na natječaj mogu podnijeti osobe oba spola sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu, kandidati su dužni priložiti:
- životopis
- dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja i stručnom znanju (diploma, svjedodžba, uvjerenje),
- elektronički zapis o radnopravnom statusu, odnosno e-radna knjižica
- preslika vozačke dozvole B kategorije.
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku, a prije izbora kandidata predočit će se izvornik.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je od dana objave Oglasa do popune radnog mjesta.
Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima po posebnim propisima, dužni su se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, uz obavezno podnošenje dokaza iz kojih je vidljivo navedeno pravo.
Nepotpune i nepravodobno podnesene prijave neće biti razmatrane. Osobe koje podnesu nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave na natječaj ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na oglas.
Prijavom na ovaj Oglas smatra se da je kandidat dao svoju privolu za obradu i objavu osobnih podataka vezano za realizaciju ovog Oglasa.
Poslodavac zadržava pravo poništiti natječaj ili ne prihvatiti niti jednu ponudu za zaposlenje.

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.

jobs.title: Bartender
jobs.description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week
; work includes night shifts

jobs.title: Cleaning Supervisor
jobs.description:
Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

If you are interested in joining our team, please send your CV together with a motivation letter or a short video introducing yourself to:

info@teamclean.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Libertex Group Overview

Established in 1997, the Libertex Group is an international powerhouse with over 28 years of financial markets expertise.

Over the years, the Libertex Group has helped shape the online trading industry by merging together innovative technology, market movements and digital trends. This was made possible with the introduction of âLibertex', the multi-awarded online trading platform with which anyone can access the market and invest in stocks or trade CFDs with underlying assets being commodities, Forex, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and others.

A firm believer in the power of sports to inspire, empower and push for success, Libertex is the Official Online Trading Partner of Audi Revolut F1Â® Team.

The Libertex Group in Numbers:

  • 28+ years of fintech experience
  • 3M+ clients worldwide
  • 700+ employees
  • 45+ international awards (for Libertex)
  • 300+ tradable assets (through Libertex)

The Libertex Group is constantly driven by a single passionate purpose - to tirelessly work on developing amazing fintech for people who simply want to have âmore' in their lives.

Job Overview

As a Business Development Manager, you will drive client acquisition and partnership growth across GCC. Your role will involve onboarding IBs, affiliates, trading academies and institutional clients while ensuring compliance with regional regulations.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a business development strategy tailored to GCC, focusing on client acquisition and retention
  • Identify, recruit, and manage Introducing Brokers (IBs), affiliates, and institutional clients in GCC
  • Act as the main point of contact for partners, ensuring their satisfaction and loyalty
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to design and deploy region-specific campaigns
  • Represent the company at expos, seminars, and events
  • Stay updated on regulatory frameworks, competitive offerings, and market trends
  • Track KPIs: revenue, client acquisition, conversion rates, and trading volumes

Requirements

  • Degree in Business Management, Marketing or any other relevant field.
  • At least 3-5 years of experience in Forex/CFD business development, with a focus on GCC markets
  • Excellent command of Arabic and English language
  • Strong network of IBs, affiliates, and traders in GCC
  • Knowledge of GCC market dynamics, including trading behaviors and regulations
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and communication skills

Benefits

  • 21 working days of annual leave
  • Work remotely whilst being part of a global team
  • Udemy Business unlimited membership
  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a fast-growing environment

Libertex Group is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive and diverse environment. We do not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by the law. Candidate privacy is respected, and all data is securely stored and used solely for recruitment purposes, in line with GDPR and our internal policies. Unsuccessful applicants may have their data retained for future opportunities unless deletion is requested.

Senior Software Engineer, Growth Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT REPLIT

Replit is building the world's most ubiquitous AI coding agent. Replit Agent can be used by anybody to bring their ideas to life. Whether it's an app for yourself, the next great startup idea, or a tool to make you more productive at work, Replit Agent can help build it. Replit is also the leader in secure vibe coding. We protect apps, give users features to manage security risks, and help them vibe code more safely.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is changing how people and companies turn ideas into software. Reaching those customers requires engineering that connects acquisition to the product experience and gives teams trustworthy evidence about what works.


This role goes beyond operating conventional marketing technology. You will rethink growth systems for a world where agents can observe performance, diagnose problems, take action, and learn from the result.


As the founding engineer for Growth Enablement, you will set the technical direction for this area. You will build agentic systems alongside shared foundations for attribution, audiences, lifecycle engagement, referrals, and promotions. The work spans web, mobile, billing, and data.


You will work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to find the highest-leverage problems and ship the first solutions. Successful projects will become platforms that help these teams move faster and give Replit a clearer view of what drives durable growth.





YOU WILL:

 - Design agentic growth systems that monitor performance, diagnose failures, run approved experiments, and improve from the results.

 - Explore AI-native approaches to answer engine optimization, campaign operations, audience discovery, and measurement.

 - Build acquisition measurement across web and mobile, including click-ID capture, identity matching, server-side conversion APIs, and warehouse attribution.

 - Create a shared standard for deep links and context transfer across web, iOS, Android, and app-store handoffs.

 - Build reusable systems for promotions, referrals, campaign landing pages, fraud controls, attribution, and holdout measurement.

 - Build audience pipelines that sync warehouse-defined cohorts and exclusions to each delivery channel.

 - Work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to turn business needs into technical systems.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise in TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, or a similar language.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse and event instrumentation.

 - Hands-on experience with attribution, marketing technology, deep linking, payment webhooks, or high-scale event pipelines.

 - A record of working with non-engineering partners to turn ambiguous business needs into shipped systems.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Built growth or martech infrastructure at a consumer or PLG company, such as referral systems, promotion platforms, lifecycle tooling, or CDPs.

 - Built agents that act on business data with clear evaluations, permissions, and human controls.

 - Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and lifecycle tools such as Iterable.

 - Familiarity with privacy and consent handling in marketing data pipelines.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience shipping mobile attribution with OneLink, Universal Links, App Links, or SKAN.

 - Experience carrying attribution through payment systems such as Stripe or Razorpay.

 - Regular use of AI agents to plan, implement, test, or review your work.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Extreme ownership: identify important work, carry it through launch, and resolve blockers quickly.

 - Data-driven decisions: define hypotheses and success criteria before launch, then change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 - No borders: solve the highest-impact problem, whether it requires a PRD, a warehouse query, code, or campaign setup.

 - Speed through reversibility: ship the smallest step that produces useful signal, and slow down for decisions that are hard to reverse.

 - Strong communication: make technical constraints and business requirements clear to engineers and go-to-market partners.
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

Your area of responsibility

You will be part of Engineering team, which supports both running production and new projects. You will have contact with Production, Quality and Maintenance colleagues.

Further responsibilities will be:

  • Supports the successful implementation of new projects, engineering and process changes, in agreement with customer, to ensure and improve quality and delivery of products, at lowest / best cost

  • Leads respective projects including cost and milestone control

  • Plans the set-up and tear-down of production equipment

jobs.title: Allmänmedicin läkare till Danmark - Vi skräddarsyr ditt nästa äventyr!
jobs.description:
Går du i tankarna på att arbeta i Danmark, antingen nu eller i framtiden? Vi söker kontinuerligt duktiga specialister i allmänmedicin för kommande och långsiktiga uppdrag över hela Danmark.

Vi vet att livet består av mer än bara jobb. Därför utgår vi alltid från dina personliga önskemål. Om du har familj, vill bo på en specifik ort eller har specifika önskemål kring ditt schema, så anpassar vi vårt sökande efter dig, inte efter en fast låst list

Vill du arbeta i ett hälso- och sjukvårdssystem som värnar om din arbetsmiljö? Här får du chansen till ett meningsfullt arbete med stor flexibilitet, rimliga patientflöden och ett starkt team av sjuksköterskor runt dig. Du kommer att få mer stöd från övrig vårdpersonal och hanterar mindre administration. Det gör att du äntligen kan fokusera på det medicinska!

Vi erbjuder ett års visstidsanställning, men ser gärna att det leder till en tillsvidareanställning.

Arbetstider och balans i livet:

Arbetet är som utgångspunkt heltid, måndag till fredag kl. 08–16, men det finns möjlighet att arbeta på minst 75 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Ekonomi och förmåner:

Som svensk specialistläkare kan du, om du uppfyller kraven, omfattas av den danska expertskatten med en fast skattesats på 32,8 %. Det innebär mer pengar kvar i plånboken och större frihet på fritiden.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

    Legitimerad läkare
    Specialist i allmänmedicin
    Kunna prata och skriva på flytande svenska
    Meriterande att kunna förstå och prata danska

Låter det intressant för dig? Ansök genom att skicka ditt CV till mig Felix på felix.hellstrom@vbsverige.se eller göra en intresseanmälan på vår hemsida (https://vbsverige.se/lakare-i-danmark/).

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design

Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution

Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success

Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance

But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Work flexibly, earn extra - Join Imercos Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary job in November and December, with the opportunity to earn extra money and gain valuable work experience? Do you enjoy being physically active and working at a fast pace? Then now is the time to seize the opportunity!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4 shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

On a typical working day, you will pack approximately 100–150 boxes, depending on the size of the orders.

We expect you to:

  • Enjoy routine-based and independent work

  • Have a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for your shifts

  • Be physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the day

  • Have good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Be available for 4 shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Be available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We also offer an exciting temporary position in a well-established and busy retail company, where you will become part of a strong team with great team spirit. You will have the opportunity to work morning, evening, or night shifts, while earning extra money during the busy season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour. In addition, evening, night, and weekend supplements are provided.

Employment terms

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application.

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.

jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

job@naka.dk

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

  • Sorting and handling freight during loading

  • Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

You will receive thorough training alongside one of our experienced drivers, allowing you to become familiar with routes, procedures, and the workplace. We are always available to support you if challenges arise during the workday.

We Expect You To:

  • Hold a Category C and/or CE driving licence

  • Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

  • Be reliable, independent, and responsible

  • Be physically fit and able to handle freight

  • Enjoy daytime work and structured routines

  • Communicate politely and professionally with customers and dispatchers

➕ It Is an Advantage If You:

  • Have experience with distribution driving or similar transport work

⭐ We Offer:

  • A permanent position in a company with well-organized working conditions

  • Well-maintained trucks

  • Thorough training in routes and procedures

  • Good colleagues and an informal working environment

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

Interested?

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@naka.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and to a successful future collaboration.

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

ZAKRES ZADAŃ NA STANOWISKU:
1. Dochodzenie należności z tytułu świadczeń i usług udzielanych na podstawie ustawy o pomocy społecznej.
2. Przygotowywanie wszcząć oraz decyzji administracyjnych
3. Wystawianie upomnień oraz tytułów wykonawczych
4. Ewidencjonowanie wpłat oraz przypisów należności w programie księgowym
5. Rozpatrywanie wniosków o rozłożenia należności cywilno-prawnych na raty
6. Monitorowanie spłat, naliczanie odsetek od nieterminowych wpłat
INFORMACJA O WARUNKACH PRACY NA PROPONOWANYM STANOWISKU
1. Warunki pracy na proponowanym stanowisku obejmują między innymi:
- wykonywanie obowiązków pod presją czasu, wymagające odporności psychicznej i radzenia sobie ze stresem,
- praca w siedzibie MOPS przy ul. Wita Stwosza 7
2. Do budynku prowadzą trzy poszerzone wejścia o szerokości min. 90 cm bezpośrednio od ulicy Wita Stwosza. Do dwóch wejść prowadzą schody oraz w świetle wejścia/wyjścia stoją przeszkody - dwa filary konstrukcyjne. Jedno z tych wejść posiada automatycznie otwierane drzwi. Trzecim wejściem można się dostać z poziomu gruntu, jest ono przewidziane dla osób ze szczególnymi potrzebami (np. niepełnosprawnością ruchową, matki z wózkami itp.). Przy tych drzwiach znajduje się dzwonek. Drzwi otwiera automatycznie portier, po użyciu dzwonka. W budynku znajduje się portiernia.
3. W obiekcie jest jedna winda, za pomocą której można się dostać na każdą jego kondygnację.
4. Miejski Ośrodek Pomocy Społecznej nie dysponuje wydzielonymi miejscami parkingowymi wyznaczonymi dla osób niepełnosprawnych. Obecnie w obrębie budynku znajdują się 2 miejsca parkingowe dla osób niepełnospra

jobs.title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
